title.en: An Act Establishing A High School At Barangay Raniag, Municipality of Ramon, Province of Isabela, To Be Known As Raniag High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Raniag, Municipality of Ramon, Province of Isabela, to be known as Raniag High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
